changes: Confirmed standard precision and recall each >=95%, with separate per-company/table denominators.
Separated source engine/LangExtract char span from engine-neutral financial correctness so generic Pi is not rejected for lacking a specialized framework.
Keep actual Pi, cache owner/result hash and semantic review evidence as financial-system workflow gates.
Definition review history may include a later independently proved temporal correction; all money/units/scope/dimensions/source and exact temporal before-after remain checked.

Every accepted primary schema/row must match the original owner actual successful response, allowing same-owner table repair composites. Review caches still require all accepted extractions in one original response. Header/note skipped rows are allowed; whole-table completeness remains independently gold-scored.

Fixed-budget comparison equates main Pi configuration and total budget, not every specialized inner inference setting. Stage-specific policies are frozen implementation and disclosed in usage audit; comparison remains system-level, not a module ablation.

Before any formal prediction, definition provenance now verifies definition-quote-location-1: exact original model attributes, same-group unique source relocation or whitespace-only alignment, Python Unicode codepoint offsets, immutable original owner/result hash, archived values and own partial-batch report. Explicit recorded definition repair may combine same-owner calls; catalog/temporal caches still require one complete original response. This supersedes only the definition-cache clause of clarification 5. No financial gold, input, exact amount, concept, unit, date, source-cell, precision or recall scoring rule changed.

Before first formal prediction, provenance accepts explicit partial_coverage only when accepted and pending groups uniquely partition the original group list; accepted spans must match the original full input and each output_limit attempt must match a real same-owner length response, request ID, input hash and pending group list. Later revalidated_cached_result receipts must bind immutable cache hash/owner and explicitly name source keys and historical review IDs. Historical absent registrations remain marked missing. No pending decision, invented output or cross-owner substitution is accepted.

Before first formal prediction, a separately recorded verified_historical_output_limit can justify a zero-new-call split only when the original audit bytes, unique request/result, original Pi owner/processing/project, complete message hash, input group hash, inference settings, original length stop/usage and current source fingerprints match. split_attempts must link the receipt and partition the parent groups exactly. Historical failures and usage retain original ownership and are not counted as newly accepted outputs or new model calls. Independent receipt validation does not claim to have executed the current split or re-generated the full current LangExtract template.
manifest_note: manifest.scorer_preparation_sha256 records initial prepared scorer. Final runner locks current scorer/helpers before any prediction and checks them after; gold/input/protocol hashes remain the original locked values.

evidence_contract_revision.reason: New production quote_alignment and per-invalid-group repair contract would be falsely rejected by the older evidence checker.
